rectify.title: Birth-Time Rectification
rectify.subtitle: Refine an uncertain birth time (experimental)
rectify.experimental: Experimental heuristic — birth-time rectification is a suggestion to verify against known life events, not an authoritative correction. Where the recorded time is reliable, trust it first.

methodDesc.nakshatra: Checks the Moon's birth star against the star expected from the exact birth moment, and nudges the time (±30 min) so they agree. Needs no extra input.
methodDesc.lagna: Checks the rising sign (Lagna) against the Moon and Maandi in the Rasi and Navamsa, nudging the time so the Lagna sits in a supportive relationship.
methodDesc.janma: Checks the classical birth-time gender indication and nudges the time so it agrees with the stated gender. Requires selecting a gender.
